name: PageLens
line: Tracks website traffic, conversions, and source-linked revenue.

cells.cookieless: Yes, no visitor cookies or local storage

pv.math: 10,000 pageviews, at one event each, fit the Starter plan's 20,000-event allowance. The plan costs $5 a month.
100,000 pageviews, at one event each, fit the Pro plan's 150,000-event allowance. The plan costs $12 a month.
1,000,000 pageviews, at one event each, fit the Pro plan's 1,000,000-event allowance. The plan costs $39 a month.
